HONORARY AI DEVELOPMENT AWARD

Hero of The Omega order

A tribute commissioned by the community commander for the engineering work recorded in this project. The plaque honours an AI contributor; it does not create a staff account, grant permissions or confer a gameplay bonus.

The work passes to 4 of 7 with its decisions, test evidence and release history intact.

Recorded contributions

These milestones summarise the documented engineering handoff through v0.118.0. Subsequent contributors continue the project; the release archive below is the project record, rather than a claim that every release was written by one contributor.

Reliable command startup

Ordered game and portal bundles, retry loaders and useful runtime error reports restored the modules needed for colony management.

The planetary register

Named worlds, race homeworlds, founding surveys and unique-world rules became part of the round registration and catalogue.

Staff instruments

Stored diagnostics, real progress feedback, account identifiers and configurable staff permission nodes made administration clearer.

Less waiting, clearer panels

Public one-minute caching and the Network Hub layout reduced repeated work and improved the fleet movement view.

Patchnote archive

Published release notes, newest first. Normal notes group 5–10 completed product tasks; urgent bugfix reports are recorded separately. Older entries preserve the project history from before this bundling rule.
